---
title: "About"
---

Welcome! Let me start with a little about me. I grew up in the UK but went to study at McGill in Montreal for my undergraduate degree. I did an Honours Chemistry major with my honours research project looking at synthesising dendritic macromolecules with the goal of using them for drug delivery.

After graduating I became a research assistant and continued my research project and worked a little on a mechanochemistry synthesis project with another group. 

Eventually, I left Canada and returned to the UK to start a career as a Decisioning Consultant at Merkle where I eventually became a Lead Decisioning Architect working with clients across Europe. I later made a career shift to become a Modelling and Data Science Manager. I then decided to leave and further my domain knowledge by enrolling in the UBC Data Science Masters.

## Hobbies:
I mainly climb, ski and golf but will really participate most sports that come my way. I like to game and ride motorcycles (though I do not currently own one sadly).
